default_properties.sim/long-description: The YF-16 is a 1975 prototype of a 4th generation fighter aircraft with a fly by wire system. Powered by F100-PW-200. The fly-by-wire in this variant offers no spin, nose-slide or deep stall protection.
default_properties.sim/author: Erik Hofman, Martin "Pegasus" Schmitt, Pensacola, Nikolai V. Chr., J Maverick 16, Richard Harrison, Josh Davidson, Martien Van Der P., Jonathan Redpath, Gary Brown, Justin Nicholson, Enrico Castaldi, Timi, Barszczisbad, PH-JAKE, Bat Campion, LJQCN101

known_defects.note: The GLB's baked animations play each part's full range; drive parts from channels within the XML limits instead.

runtime_notes: GLB already uses the mapped frame; do not apply the map twice.
Source conditions retain Boolean operators; categories are advisory.
Body/logo paint groups recovered from main author XML; stores textures omitted because no stores are selected.
82 named liveries: original80 plus the omitted selected YF-16 and Combat Gray entries. Paint switching does not change production-block geometry.

source_recovery.note: Author upstream matches canopy30/hook57.175/gear112/95/offsets; missing main include recovered. Pack geometry/frame preserved.
